up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725969'. This document is identified in the 'docs' table by its 'chembl_id' column. The compounds linked to this document are found through the 'compound_records' table, which has 'doc_id' referencing 'docs' and 'molregno' referencing 'molecule_dictionary'. For each such compound, return the following three columns: the ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id) from 'molecule_dictionary', the preferred name (pref_name) from 'molecule_dictionary', and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) from 'compound_structures'. Ensure each distinct compound appears only once in the results (i.e., use DISTINCT over the three output columns).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725969';
